versions.subject: feat: update bitsadmin rules and other
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\certoc.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'CertOC.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -LoadDLL '
        - ' /LoadDLL '
selection_paths:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - '\Appdata\Local\Temp\'
        - '\Desktop\'
        - '\Downloads\'
        - '\Users\Public\'
        - 'C:\Windows\Tasks\'
        - 'C:\Windows\Temp\'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: Image="*\\certoc.exe" OR OriginalFileName="CertOC.exe" CommandLine IN ("* -LoadDLL *", "* /LoadDLL *") CommandLine IN ("*\\Appdata\\Local\\Temp\\*", "*\\Desktop\\*", "*\\Downloads\\*", "*\\Users\\Public\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\Tasks\\*", "*C:\\Windows\\Temp\\*")
